capabilities: Chat with vault notes in a multi-tab sidebar with file context and slash commands
Read, edit, create, move, and delete notes through vault-native tools
Delegate tasks to concurrent subagents with configurable permissions
Extend the agent with vault-local Agent Skills and remote MCP servers
Search the web and generate images into notes from chat
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian v1.13.0+); macOS supported, Windows and Linux in preview, mobile unsupported. Pre-release builds install via BRAT. Bash, command execution, external file access, and the Obsidian CLI are off by default with approval gates. Development is funded through Patreon and Afdian.
intentEvidence: no desktop app, no terminal, no Claude Code / Codex mode
motivation: The author wanted a vault-native AI for knowledge work rather than a repurposed coding agent, built for writers who want precise collaboration instead of black-box generation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI agent, and coding-oriented agents treat notes as plain file paths instead of understanding wikilinks, frontmatter, and backlinks.

relations.evidence: Pi agent core — The Pi agent runtime that powers Pivi
Claudian — Code lineage this version is adapted from
Install kepano/obsidian-skills or other Agent Skills into .pivi/skills/
With the Style Settings plugin installed, customize chat typography
Add the current editor selection or a custom Pivi command to an installed Note Toolbar selected-text toolbar

summary: AI agent sidebar that chats with vault notes, edits them with vault-native tools, and extends through skills, MCP servers, and concurrent subagents.
